title: Factors influencing short-term and long-term survival rates in stroke patients receiving enteral nutrition: a machine learning approach using MIMIC-IV database.
summary: MIMIC-IV records were screened and 81 eligible patients were analyzed for survival outcomes and model-based risk factors.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models identify factors associated with short- and long-term survival among stroke patients receiving enteral nutrition.

evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
